live_budget: Ditto must draw 1 s of voice in well under 1 s on the pod (co-host 0.35-0.5 s on L40S; Nova 1.1-1.2 s = lips fall behind).

engine.why: knees-up shot: Ditto repaints only the lips on top of a moving body video (body, hands, hair untouched). SoulX-FlashHead draws a 512 head only - it cannot keep a body.

items.why: Frames without a face get no lips (her own mouth shows, or a frozen frame).

items.measured: pitch_range_deg SOFTEN, roll_range_deg SOFTEN, disp_p95_pct REJECT, rot_v_p95_deg SOFTEN, smo_res_p95_deg REJECT
items.why: Fast turns/nods make Ditto's face crop jump and the lips slide (clips >= 3.9 % disp lost the face).
items.fix: Use the calmer stretches (bank segments that PASS) or ask for slower movement; SOFTEN alone is usable (Nova went live on SOFTEN).

items.threshold: body shot or moving video -> Ditto; bust/face still (face >= 20 % of H) or face-filling video (>= 35 %) -> SoulX
items.why: knees-up shot: Ditto repaints only the lips on top of a moving body video (body, hands, hair untouched). SoulX-FlashHead draws a 512 head only - it cannot keep a body.
enough real lip detail for Ditto

items.measured: 206 px (source 206 x 1.000; canvas 1080x1920, body at 1 x H)
items.threshold: >= 200 px (150-200 borderline; Maya co-host Large 118 px = 'horrible')
items.why: Viewers judge lips at the size they see them. A small on-screen mouth reads as mush however good the engine.

items.measured: Laplacian var 21 at a 300 px face (mouth @256 0.14)
items.threshold: >= 80 OK, 20-80 WARN, < 20 FIX (Seyzar bank 8s 99 vs bank 7 52; take-7 cut 1080 54 / 720 36; Nova dance raw 14). Skin texture matters (beard high, smooth make-up low): compare against the SAME person's native file.
items.why: A soft source gives soft lips; Ditto copies the texture around the mouth. Take 8 doubled it (bank 7 -> 8s) by going native-res + light unsharp.
items.fix: Use the native-res file; light sharpen only: ffmpeg -vf unsharp=5:5:0.7:5:5:0.0 (never stronger, never GFPGAN/CodeFormer).

items.why: Low corr = mouth not shaped by the words.
items.fix: Check AV offset / DITTO_PRIME delay line, then the body's mouth (closed patch).

items.measured: core silence 2.43; with transitions (lipmove def) 2.66; speaking 3.69
items.why: Above ~1.2 the mouth reads as moving when they are not talking.
items.fix: Fix the SOURCE: build_bank_v3.py --ref <closed frame> --crf 12; calmer head; DITTO_PASTE_GATE=1.

items.why: An open or pursed mouth in a pause is the 'deaf / chewing' look Refael rejected (takes 2-4).
items.fix: Closed-mouth patch on the body (build_bank_v3.py), DITTO_PASTE_GATE=1, DITTO_MASK=lower.

items.check: body motion (mean frame diff, picture area)
items.threshold: >= 1.0 (jewellery lead real clip 4.77 / Seyzar real 1.73; Kling statue 0.92; take-1 loop 0.07)
items.why: A still body with a moving mouth reads as a dead puppet (Refael: 'the body is still', 'frozen').
No blinks = doll; constant blinking = nervous, and it was on Refael's error sheet.
items.fix: Pick a calmer stretch / re-record; do not fix with warps.

items.threshold: <= 6.0 % (Maya 9.0 px at a 118 px face = 7.6 %, flagged)
items.why: Too much sway reads as nervous and moves Ditto's crop; zero reads as a statue (judge with body motion).

items.threshold: <= 2 (Maya talk bank 24 = double images on air; morph rebuild 1)
items.why: A pixel crossfade inside the body shows two faces at once; Ditto then draws lips on a ghost.
